notes:
Account summary: mid-to-large engineering org building internal developer search + code-assistant. Primary requirement: large-scale embedding store (5-30M vectors) for code + docs, frequent re-indexing (near-RT for active repos, nightly delta windows), and high-quality reranking to reduce false positives in PR search.

Key quotes from CTO: "Need sub-200ms retrieval p95 and <600ms end-to-end for code completions in IDE; cost per query (average) must be under $0.005 at scale or project won't be viable."

Technical priorities:
- Indexing scale: planning 10M initial vectors, growth ≈ 2–5M/month. Concern about storage footprint and shard distribution.
- Re-indexing: hybrid model: nightly full delta + real-time upserts for changed files/PRs. Need low-latency upsert (target <5s to be searchable).
- Latency/throughput: target 150–200ms p95 for ANN retrieval; end-to-end (retrieval + rerank + model decode) p95 <=600ms for interactive flows. Throughput target 100 qps sustained for search endpoint used by internal tools.
- Reranking: two-stage pipeline: cheap ANN retrieval (disk/quantized) -> CPU/GPU reranker for top-50. Reranker must support model variants (smaller transformer on CPU for cost-sensitive routes).
- Cost targets: $0.002–0.005 per query (target depends on SLA tier); want recommendations on batching/quantization to hit numbers.
- Data governance: strict code residency for certain repos (EU), SSO/SAML + granular audit logs, KMS integration for key rotation.

Evaluation constraints: the team will run a POC with 10M vectors and synthetic query load mirroring internal IDE usage. Will measure recall@k, MRR, end-to-end latency and cost. SE and infra need a private VPC deployment with canary fallback to hosted Redwood for metabolic workloads.

Behavioral/context notes: Eng leads care about deterministic performance (no noisy neighbors), transparent perf benchmarks; security frequently escalates for on-prem components. Familiar with Pinecone and Elastic but unhappy with reindexing workflows and rerank accuracy.
